name: Mission-Edit
prompt: Premium commercial game UI concept for an original modern Korean urban life simulation called Ian Growing. Modern dense pixel art, tired ordinary protagonist, dry humor about work, education, debt, investing. Practical civic design, charcoal ink, muted blue-grey, warm uncoated paper, desaturated jade and selective oxblood seal. Group related data, stepped pixel edges, aligned numerals, restrained ink rules, explicit focus states, readable Korean. Show one finished straight-on game frame. No logos, generic mobile decoration, excessive frames, fantasy or web dashboard. Preserve the illustrated chapter stub and separate action controls. Refine only the reward voucher hierarchy and contrast; it must reproduce clearly in a compact window. Single game screenshot ONLY. Do not make a moodboard or multiple screens.
